title: Key West Day Sail on Schooner America 2.0 with 2 Drinks
includes: 2 alcoholic drinks are included with your ticket for those 21 and older
Additional beer, wine, mimosas, and cocktails available for purchase onboard by credit card (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Travelers must arrive 30-45 minutes prior to the scheduled departure time to check-in at the ticket booth for boarding passes
Kids sail FREE on our afternoon departures! All people planning to attend need to have a ticket. Please select tickets accordingly at check out for each traveler planning to attend
policies: Operates in all weather conditions unless unsafe, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Sail aboard the fastest and most elegant schooner in Key West, Schooner America 2.0! This boat is a replica of the 1851 Schooner America that won the first America's Cup Race in 1851. Admire her beauty on the clear, calm Caribbean waters while sipping a beverage. Take in views of Key West sights like Fort Zachary Taylor, Mallory Square, Sunset Pier and Sand Key Light Tower. Soda and water are complimentary. Two alcoholic beverages are included with your ticket. Additional beverages are available for purchase.
